title: Bram and the Colony
author: Ines Thornbury
blurb: Freya Brightwater, the last human technician on an automated relay station, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
